mapper.insert: INSERT INTO inquiry (member_id, category, title, content, reply_email) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{category}, #{title}, #{content}, #{replyEmail})
mapper.update: UPDATE inquiry SET inquiry_number = #{inquiryNumber} WHERE inquiry_id = #{inquiryId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO inquiry_attachment (inquiry_id, file_name, file_url, file_size) VALUES (#{inquiryId}, #{fileName}, #{fileUrl}, #{fileSize})
mapper.select: SELECT attachment_id, file_name, file_url, file_size FROM inquiry_attachment WHERE inquiry_id = #{inquiryId} ORDER BY attachment_id ASC
